what_to_detect: The static that dash generates contributes haste to a permanent whose dash cost was paid.
near_miss: A permanent printing dash cast for its mana cost: the dash static applies to the board and contributes no haste.
record_fields: acting line (the Dash keyword line claims the dash static, static index 0)
note: continuous_contribution has no filter on the acting static's line, so keywords haste tags every haste-granting static as this rule.
